title: Middleware RCE Quick Reference (Version → CVE → Nuclei)
description: Highest-frequency middleware vulnerability table to test immediately when a fingerprint matches
detail: Fingerprint → approach mapping (nuclei templates are built in; use -tags to select): Log4j2 ≤2.14 (Log4Shell); Spring Boot ≤2.3 (Actuator exposure + VM); Shiro ≤1.5.1 (rememberMe deserialization); Fastjson ≤1.2.47 (autoType RCE); WebLogic (CVE-2019-2725/2888); Confluence (CVE-2022-26134 OGNL); GitLab (CVE-2021-22205 ExifTool); ThinkPHP 5.x (invokefunction route RCE, payload shaped like s=index/think plus app/invokefunction). Workflow: pin down the version → check this table → verify with nuclei -u T -tags X → obtain RCE and read the proof artifact.
